ACN.headline: Why Did Infosys Stock Pop on Thursday?
ACN.description: Infosys stock jumped 6.6% on Thursday following Accenture's strong Q4 earnings beat, which exceeded analyst expectations on both revenue ($18.7B vs $18B expected) and earnings ($3.29 vs $3.19 EPS expected). Investors are extrapolating Accenture's positive results to anticipate similar strong performance from Infosys when it reports earnings on October 23. ACN.headline: Accenture's Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase 6% Y/Y
ACN.description: Accenture delivered impressive Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings of $3.29 per share (up 8.6% YoY) and revenues of $18.7B (up 6.2% YoY), both beating consensus estimates. The company projects FY27 local-currency revenue growth of 3-6% with EPS of $14.39-$14.81. Managed Services bookings led at $12.77B, and the company expanded operating margins to 15.3%. FactSet Research and Paychex also reported strong quarterly results.

ACN.headline: Why Accenture Stock Soared on Thursday
ACN.description: Accenture stock surged 22.2% after beating earnings expectations with $3.29 EPS on $18.7B in quarterly revenue. The consulting giant reported 6% YoY revenue growth and significant margin expansion, with Q4 profits jumping 46%. However, the analyst suggests the stock may now be overvalued at 15.5x forward earnings, preferring an entry point closer to 12x earnings.

ACN.headline: Accenture (ACN) Tops Q4 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
ACN.description: Accenture reported Q2 2026 earnings of $3.29 per share, beating consensus estimates of $3.19, with revenues of $18.68 billion exceeding expectations by 3.68%. However, the stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 31.7% year-to-date. The company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market.

ACN.headline: CDW's Buyback Pace Jumps: Can Stronger Cash Flow Sustain Returns?
ACN.description: CDW returned $706 million to shareholders in H1 2026, including $545 million in buybacks, with net leverage at 2.5X and over $1.1 billion in remaining buyback capacity. However, adjusted free cash flow conversion remained below management's 80-90% target at 42% of non-GAAP net income, primarily due to working capital timing and inventory buildup. Management expects inventory rationalization to drive improved cash flow in H2 2026.
